name: "G-13 Skunk"  Indoor Pre-Roll | 1G
description: G13 Skunk roars onto the scene like a muscle car with no muffler—pure octane-fueled power wrapped in a cloud of skunky funk. Zesty lime cuts through thick diesel and rich gas, revving up your senses before this heavyweight indica slams the brakes, locking you into deep, unshakable relaxation. The inhale is a rush of sour citrus and earthy skunk, while the exhale lingers with a bold mix of spicy fuel and tangy lime peel. Bold, loud, and built for the long haul—buckle up, hit the gas, and let the road fade away.
